# NullForge Automatically builds and publishes APKs & Magisk/KernelSU Modules whenever new patches are released. ## 🔗 Links - 🌐 [Download Website](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/nullstore) - 🗄️ [Build Archive](https://github.com/nullcpy/archive/releases) - 💬 [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/d4VHpybpQq) - 👥 [Telegram Group](https://t.me/nullstoretg) - 📣 [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/s/nullstore_updates) - ❤️ [Donate](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/donate) - 🐞 [Report an Issue](https://github.com/nullcpy/rvb/issues/new/choose) ## 📊 Stats

## 🤝 Support the Project Building, testing, and maintaining these automated workflows takes a significant amount of time. If this builder has saved you time or made your life easier, any support is hugely appreciated! - **❤️ [Donate](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/donate)** if you can. - **⭐ Star this repository** (This is a huge help!) - **📢 Share the project** with others who might find it useful. Thank you to everyone who helps keep this project alive! > [!NOTE] > > 🌐 **[Visit Download Website](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/nullstore)** > > For the best experience, please download from the website. It features: > > - 📱 **The complete list of every supported app.** > - 📦 Clear separation between **Stable**, **Beta** and **Variant** builds. > - 🏷️ Beautifully organized version numbers and download tracking. > - 🔄 Step-by-step instructions on how to set up automatic updates using **Obtainium** and easy **Add to Obtainium** button. > > **🤖 Fully Automated Builds** > > All APKs and modules in this repository are 100% automated. Direct each request to the right place: > > - 🐞 **Requests & issues → GitHub.** **[Open an Issue](https://github.com/nullcpy/rvb/issues/new/choose)** to **request a new app**, **request a patch**, or **report a problem** (an app fails to build, a download link is broken, the catalog looks wrong). Not comfortable with GitHub? Raise it on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/d4VHpybpQq)** instead. If a **feature inside a specific patch** is misbehaving (e.g., ads still showing), file it in the **respective patch developer's repository** so the fix reaches everyone. > - 💬 **Everything else → Discord.** Install help, general questions, and community chat all happen on the **[Discord server](https://discord.gg/d4VHpybpQq)**. > - 📣 **Announcements** are posted on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/d4VHpybpQq)**; only **major** updates are also posted on the **GitHub**. ## 📚 Documentation Everything about **how this project works** lives in [**`docs/`**](docs/): the architecture, what each CI stage does, where every file and branch lives, how these releases feed the download website, and how to set up a local build or contribute. - Start here → [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) - Adding or changing an app → [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md) - AI agents → [docs/ai-context.md](docs/ai-context.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - App/patch configuration reference → [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md) ## 💖 Credits & Acknowledgements This automated builder would not be possible without the incredible work and dedication of the open-source Android community. A massive thank you to: - **[peternmuller](https://github.com/peternmuller)**, **[nvbangg](https://github.com/nvbangg/revanced-morphe-builder)**, and **[j-hc](https://github.com/j-hc)** for their phenomenal foundational build scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and automation logic that power the core of this repository. - **The Patch Maintainers:** Huge appreciation to the development teams behind **ReVanced**, **MorpheApp**, **Anddea**, **RVX**, **Piko**, **De-Vanced**, and all the other independent developers who spend countless hours reverse-engineering, updating, and keeping these patches alive for everyone. _If you enjoy using these builds, please consider starring their upstream repositories and supporting the original patch developers!_

NullForge

Automatically builds and publishes APKs & Magisk/KernelSU Modules whenever new patches are released.

🔗 Links

  • 🌐 [Download Website](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/nullstore)
  • 🗄️ [Build Archive](https://github.com/nullcpy/archive/releases)
  • 💬 [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/d4VHpybpQq)
  • 👥 [Telegram Group](https://t.me/nullstoretg)
  • 📣 [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/s/nullstore_updates)
  • ❤️ [Donate](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/donate)
  • 🐞 [Report an Issue](https://github.com/nullcpy/rvb/issues/new/choose)

    • 📊 Stats

    🤝 Support the Project

    Building, testing, and maintaining these automated workflows takes a significant amount of time. If this builder has saved you time or made your life easier, any support is hugely appreciated!

  • **❤️ [Donate](https://fahim-ahmed05.github.io/donate)** if you can.
  • **⭐ Star this repository** (This is a huge help!)
  • **📢 Share the project** with others who might find it useful.

    • Thank you to everyone who helps keep this project alive!

    > [!NOTE]

    >

    > 🌐 Visit Download Website

    >

    > For the best experience, please download from the website. It features:

    >

    > - 📱 The complete list of every supported app.

    > - 📦 Clear separation between Stable, Beta and Variant builds.

    > - 🏷️ Beautifully organized version numbers and download tracking.

    > - 🔄 Step-by-step instructions on how to set up automatic updates using Obtainium and easy Add to Obtainium button.

    >

    > 🤖 Fully Automated Builds

    >

    > All APKs and modules in this repository are 100% automated. Direct each request to the right place:

    >

    > - 🐞 Requests & issues → GitHub. Open an Issue to request a new app, request a patch, or report a problem (an app fails to build, a download link is broken, the catalog looks wrong). Not comfortable with GitHub? Raise it on Discord instead. If a feature inside a specific patch is misbehaving (e.g., ads still showing), file it in the respective patch developer's repository so the fix reaches everyone.

    > - 💬 Everything else → Discord. Install help, general questions, and community chat all happen on the Discord server.

    > - 📣 Announcements are posted on Discord; only major updates are also posted on the GitHub.

    📚 Documentation

    Everything about how this project works lives in docs/: the

    architecture, what each CI stage does, where every file and branch lives, how these

    releases feed the download website, and how to set up a local build or contribute.

  • Start here → [docs/README.md](docs/README.md)
  • Adding or changing an app → [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md)
  • AI agents → [docs/ai-context.md](docs/ai-context.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
  • App/patch configuration reference → [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)

    • 💖 Credits & Acknowledgements

    This automated builder would not be possible without the incredible work and dedication of the open-source Android community. A massive thank you to:

  • **[peternmuller](https://github.com/peternmuller)**, **[nvbangg](https://github.com/nvbangg/revanced-morphe-builder)**, and **[j-hc](https://github.com/j-hc)** for their phenomenal foundational build scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and automation logic that power the core of this repository.
  • **The Patch Maintainers:** Huge appreciation to the development teams behind **ReVanced**, **MorpheApp**, **Anddea**, **RVX**, **Piko**, **De-Vanced**, and all the other independent developers who spend countless hours reverse-engineering, updating, and keeping these patches alive for everyone.

    • _If you enjoy using these builds, please consider starring their upstream repositories and supporting the original patch developers!_
